text.description_html:
MNG 18226, Crystal Bellagio Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull

The Crystal Bellagio Cabinet Pull is covered in crystal rhinestones for a stunning look. This Crystal Bellagio Polished Chrome Cabinet Pull is great for modern and traditional homes because old or new, everyone loves a little glam in their life. These blinged out cabinet pulls come packaged with the mounting hardware. The polished chrome finish adds to the shine of the cabinet handle. Choose from 2 sizes: 3-3/4 inches or 5 inches.

Too much crystal? Check out the Crystals on Edge Bellagio Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the MNG 18226 Crystal Bellagio Pull in Polished Chrome:

  • Base Material: Zinc / Crystal
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available in 2 Sizes:

    MNG-18226:
    • C/C Length: 3-3/4"
    • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
    • Width: 3/4"
    • Projection: 3/4"

    MNG-18326:
    • C/C Length: 5"
    • Total Length: 7"
    • Width: 5/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"

Sold Individually This cabinet pull is part of the MNG Bellagio Collection.
